title: From living systems to no free lunch
basis: Conceptual dependencies plus pedagogical ordering; no measured learner validation.

steps.title: Living systems have costs
steps.learner_question: Why is energy not identical to fitness?
steps.verification_prompt: Specify the reproductive endpoint and any intervening life-history assumptions.

steps.title: What makes a difference evolutionary?
steps.learner_question: What makes improved performance an evolutionary response?
steps.verification_prompt: Distinguish heritable population change from individual learning and drift.

steps.title: A home, resources, and a route
steps.learner_question: Does a route penalty require a search for an evaluator?
steps.verification_prompt: State the physical cost model and separate it from the reproductive bridge.

steps.title: From a physical mechanism to a landscape
steps.learner_question: Which landscape assignments can this mechanism produce?
steps.verification_prompt: Identify the geometry and physical constraints before proposing a probability law.

steps.title: What no free lunch actually averages
steps.learner_question: What changes when the function orbit is completed?
steps.verification_prompt: Compare the two explicit non-repeating policies and keep the ensemble weights fixed.

steps.title: Changing the contest changes the theorem
steps.learner_question: Is absence of a champion a sufficient biological NFL premise?
steps.verification_prompt: State the endpoint, averaging law and revisiting assumptions; distinguish organism design from natural evolution.

steps.title: Information access has a price
steps.learner_question: Why can the better information interface cost more?
steps.verification_prompt: Hold the discovery endpoint fixed and state whether the budget counts calls or elementary tests.

steps.title: Which distribution over searches?
steps.learner_question: Does uniform simplex volume describe a physical generator?
steps.verification_prompt: Identify the random object, target event, probability measure and missing measure-transfer premise.

steps.title: What the present work adds
steps.learner_question: Which results establish tracking, and which establish complexity?
steps.verification_prompt: Keep model endpoints separate and identify established prior criticism.

steps.title: What remains unresolved
steps.learner_question: Which conclusion requires an additional premise?
steps.verification_prompt: Name a missing empirical, mathematical or causal-identification bridge rather than asserting a universal result.
